info.title: Scenario Planning M0 proposal
info.description: Not API_READY. Reject unknown/repeated query fields and unknown body fields. List ordering created_at DESC,id DESC; opaque cursor binds actor/factory/workspace/filter. Draft PATCH replaces all editable fields and checks expected_revision. Canonical override order is type then target; hash independent of override ordering. Weights finite 0..1e6 with sum >1e-12. Duration 1..43200 minutes. Sweep values explicit, unique, 1..7; Frontend default 5. FLEX engine/result/metric/sampling and DEFER LIVE mapping remain joint dependencies.
